input.command: KEY=$(grep "MYLYNX_API_KEY" ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml | sed -E 's/.*:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"'"']//g'); date; curl -s -w "|http %{http_code}" --max-time 90 http://localhost:20128/v1/messages -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"model":"lynx harness","max_tokens":5,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' | head -c 500; echo; powershell -NoProfile -Command "\$o=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; 'free MB: ' + [int](\$o.FreePhysicalMemory/1024)"
input.description: Check OmniRoute model, quota and free memory
